parameters.help_en: The instance identity of the associated product. You must use an existing instance that the invoker is authorized to access. The instance must match the instance to which the scenario, channel, and session belong. The maximum length is subject to the current POP parameter definitions
parameters.help_zh: 所属产品的实例标识。必须使用调用者有权访问且确实存在的实例；应与场景、渠道和会话所属实例保持一致。最大长度以当前POP参数定义为准
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the dialog scenario under the instance. You must specify an existing scenario. Subsequent dialog and session termination requests for the same text session must use the same scenario that was used to start the session
parameters.help_zh: 实例下的对话场景标识。请填写实际存在的场景；同一文本会话的后续对话和结束请求应使用开启会话时的场景
parameters.name: script_id

parameters.help_en: The session ID used to uniquely identify the current interaction. For a text session, use the text- prefixed ID returned when the session is started. For web voice, use the ws- prefixed ID. For outbound call tests with real numbers, use the test- prefixed ID. Subsequent calls must use the actual returned values
parameters.help_zh: 用于唯一关联本次交互的会话标识。文本会话为开启会话返回的text-标识，网页语音为ws-标识，真实号码外呼测试为test-标识；后续调用必须使用实际返回值
parameters.name: session_id

schema.description_en: The business response of the API operation. A Code value of OK indicates success, and the Data field contains the corresponding business result. For business errors, troubleshoot the issue by using the Message and Params fields
schema.description_zh: 本次API的业务响应，Code=OK表示成功，Data为对应业务结果；业务错误结合Message及Params排查

Code.description_en: The business processing status code. A value of OK indicates success. If an exception occurs, the corresponding business error code is returned. The error types and mapping rules follow the current API configuration. No error codes are added or modified for this operation
Code.description_zh: 业务处理状态码，OK表示成功；发生异常时返回对应的业务错误码。错误类型和映射规则沿用当前API配置，本次不新增或修改错误码

Data.description_en: The session ID of the terminated text session, which corresponds to the session ID in the request. The service still returns this ID even if the session context has expired
Data.description_zh: 本次结束的文本会话SessionId，与请求SessionId对应；上下文已过期时结束服务仍返回该标识

HttpStatusCode.description_en: The HTTP status code recorded in the business response body. A value of 200 indicates a normal response. To determine whether the business operation is successful, you must also check the Code field. You cannot determine the success of the call based solely on the presence of this field
HttpStatusCode.description_zh: 业务响应体记录的HTTP状态码，正常返回为200。判断业务是否成功还应检查Code，不能仅凭该字段存在认定调用成功

Message.description_en: The business response or error message. This field is usually empty or omitted for successful requests. For failed requests, it provides an error description to assist in troubleshooting. Use this field in conjunction with the Code and Params fields to identify the cause of the error. The example shows the error message returned when an instance does not exist, which corresponds to the NotExists.InstanceId error code. This example is for format reference only
Message.description_zh: 业务响应或错误说明。成功时通常为空或不返回，不能要求成功时固定返回某段文本；失败时为错误说明，用于辅助排查，并结合Code与Params理解错误原因。示例为实例不存在时的错误消息（对应Code为NotExists.InstanceId），仅作格式参考

Params.description_en: The list of parameters used to localize error messages. These are not scenario variables or business results. A successful response usually returns an empty array. If an error occurs, the parameters corresponding to the error template may be returned
Params.description_zh: 用于错误消息本地化展示的参数列表，不是场景变量或业务结果。正常成功响应通常为空数组；出现错误时可能返回与错误模板对应的参数

items.description_en: A parameter value in the error message template. The specific content depends on the current error. The InstanceId example demonstrates a possible field name and does not indicate that this value is returned for every call
items.description_zh: 错误消息模板中的一个参数值。具体内容由本次错误决定；示例InstanceId仅演示可能的字段名，不表示每次调用均返回该值

RequestId.description_en: The ID used to trace and troubleshoot the current POP request. The value in the response corresponds to the current request. System request parameters are injected by the gateway, so you do not need to specify system fields
RequestId.description_zh: 用于关联和排查本次POP请求的标识。响应中的值对应本次请求；系统请求参数由网关注入，调用者不需要自行填写系统字段
